verdict.rationale: GitHub documents its pull request workflow as a way to create and review code (github-docs-69). Its docs also cover reviewing a diff and then creating a PR (github-docs-26), reviewing PRs from mobile and the CLI (github-docs-71, github-docs-75), and Copilot code review that offers suggested changes (github-docs-25). The core open-PR, compare-diff and review flow is clearly delivered, but no evidence explicitly describes line-level inline comments alongside the code. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of inline line-by-line review comments, detailed diff-comparison docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
